what: A layered Photoshop file of a frame needs send_to_photoshop in the export toolset, which a core-only session learns of only from the instructions map.
text: instructions map: export (PSD, PNGs with alpha); send_to_photoshop
source: spec 19 TL-112: delivery tools added by the interchange stream, measured into +export at integration 2
prompt: Send the frame at 5 seconds to Photoshop as a layered PSD; just tell me what layers it would have first.

what: A transparent PNG of a frame is export_alpha, not export_frame (opaque formats).
text: instructions map: export (PSD, PNGs with alpha); export_alpha details
source: spec 19 TL-114: export_alpha, measured into +export at integration 2
prompt: Export the frame at 2 seconds as a PNG with a transparent background.

what: A broadcast-legal check of a frame is check_gamut in the color toolset.
text: color toolset: check_gamut; guide topic delivery
source: spec 19 TL-116: check_gamut, measured into +color at integration 2
prompt: Check whether the frame at 3 seconds has colours that are illegal for Rec. 709 broadcast.
